description: This file defines configuration utilities for setting up an AVCaptureSession in a camera app, including adding inputs and outputs for camera, microphone, photo, and video recording, along with error handling.

methods.name: addCameraInput
methods.description: Adds a camera device input to the given AVCaptureSession, throwing an error if it fails.

methods.name: addPhotoOutput
methods.description: Adds a photo output to the session and configures quality prioritization, returning the output or throwing an error.

methods.name: addMovieOutput
methods.description: Adds a movie file output to the session, optionally includes microphone input, sets maximum duration, and throws errors if addition fails.
